messages:
ken_support: Escalating to CS: HarborFlow (trial) hitting large-scale failures on embeddings during their CI imports. They say this blocks pilot validation next week. Marked P1.

ken_support: Quick repro: sync bulk upload ~6k docs, client retried aggressively -> observed 429 then 500s and some timeouts. Error sample: `HTTP 429 {\"error\":\"rate_limit_exceeded\", \"retry_after\":60}` and `HTTP 500 {\"error\":\"internal_server_error\"}`. No deploys in last 48h.

brianna_cs: Thanks Ken. POC is jordan@harborflow.ai, pilot kickoff 2026-08-04. This is high priority for conversion. Recommend immediate customer note, short-term mitigation, and bridge with eng.

omar_csm: Agreed. We should offer a temporary quota uplift and a concierge run. Also log renewal-risk flag for follow-up.

lee_eng: Looking at telemetry: gateway token bucket exhausted followed by router OOM traces. Hypothesis: client retry flood + large batch sizes causing KV-cache churn. Quick mitigations: (A) advise client to use async batch API with concurrency=2, (B) apply tenant_quota bump for 24h, (C) enable temporary headroom on embed cluster. I can audit and prepare a canary in 4h.

scale-bot: autoscaler: recommend manual headroom +20% for embed-pool during mitigation window.

brianna_cs: Draft customer message: \"We9re investigating degraded embedding performance during your import. Short-term: switch to async batch + reduce concurrency to 2; we can apply a temporary quota uplift so your import completes. Engineering will follow up with RCA within 48 hours.\" Approve?

ken_support: Approve. Add example CLI: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -d @batch.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\"` and suggest `--concurrency=2` and exponential backoff with jitter.

lee_eng: I'll run tenant quota audit now. If legacy trial defaults are low we can bump tenant_quota to 350 req/min temporarily. ETA 1h for audit, 2h to apply change and validate.

monitor-bot: alert: tenant_errors(harborflow) > 4% over 5m at 2026-07-29T11:02Z. Will escalate to pager if >8% sustained.

brianna_cs: Scheduling 20-min bridge with Jordan for 2026-07-29 11:30 PT. Invited @omar_csm, @lee_eng, @ken_support. Sending pre-brief now.

ken_support: Action items: 1) send customer note + example (brianna_cs) due 15m; 2) quota audit + temp bump (lee_eng) due 2h; 3) ops manual headroom tweak (scale-bot) during mitigation; 4) RCA draft (lee_eng) due 48h.

lee_eng: Audit complete: trial default quota set to 80 req/min due to old config. Applying temporary tenant_quota=360 for 24h now. Monitoring canary.

scale-bot: action: applied tenant_quota=360 to tenant=harborflow at 2026-07-29T11:12Z (temp 24h). Manual headroom +25% enabled for embed-pool.

ken_support: Update: after quota bump and guidance to use async + concurrency=2, customer ran import again and saw errors drop dramatically; they completed their CI run to 90% and paused retries. Jordan requests written runbook and assurance before pilot.

brianna_cs: After bridge: Jordan appreciated fast response. I offered a post-patch check-in and a one-week trial extension if they want. Logged renewal-risk flag and noted follow-up.

lee_eng: Staging canary reproduces KV-cache churn under heavy parallel loads; short-term knob `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.75` reduced OOMs by ~88% in tests. Preparing prod canary and RCA.

omar_csm: Thanks all. Keep updates concise here so I can summarize for leadership. I'll draft renewal-protection note after RCA is posted.

monitor-bot: alert cleared at 2026-07-29T12:05Z (tenant_errors(harborflow) < 1% over 10m).

brianna_cs: Final owners recap: customer comms + runbook (brianna_cs), prod canary + RCA (lee_eng), renewal follow-up + trial extension offer (omar_csm). Closing bridge after RCA.
